cases.question: What are the requirements for crew shore passes in Rotterdam and Singapore?
cases.reference_answer: In Rotterdam, bunkering requires a completed safety checklist. In Singapore, shore passes are required for all crew going ashore.
key_facts: Bunkering requires a completed safety checklist
Shore passes are required for all crew

According to rotterdam port guide (1. Pre-arrival Notice), which number belongs in the blank: "Vessels must send the pre-arrival notification at least ____ hours before arrival."
cases.reference_answer: Vessels must send the pre-arrival notification at least 24 hours before arrival.

cases.question: According to rotterdam port guide (2. Pilotage), which number belongs in the blank: "Pilotage is compulsory for vessels longer than ____ metres."
cases.reference_answer: Pilotage is compulsory for vessels longer than 75 metres.

cases.question: According to rotterdam port guide (3. Berthing and Mooring), which number belongs in the blank: "Vessels over ____ metres require at least 2 tugs."
cases.reference_answer: Vessels over 200 metres require at least 2 tugs.

cases.question: According to rotterdam port guide (4. Weather Limits), which number belongs in the blank: "Cargo operations at container berths stop when wind speed exceeds ____ km/h."
cases.reference_answer: Cargo operations at container berths stop when wind speed exceeds 50 km/h.

cases.question: According to singapore port guide (1. Pre-arrival Notice), which number belongs in the blank: "Vessels must submit the arrival declaration at least ____ hours before arrival."
cases.reference_answer: Vessels must submit the arrival declaration at least 12 hours before arrival.

cases.question: According to singapore port guide (2. Pilotage), which number belongs in the blank: "Pilotage is compulsory for vessels of ____ gross tonnage and above."
cases.reference_answer: Pilotage is compulsory for vessels of 300 gross tonnage and above.

cases.question: According to singapore port guide (4. Weather Limits), which number belongs in the blank: "Bunkering is suspended during lightning warnings and when wind speed exceeds ____ km/h."
cases.reference_answer: Bunkering is suspended during lightning warnings and when wind speed exceeds 45 km/h.

cases.question: According to singapore port guide (5. Crew Shore Leave), which number belongs in the blank: "Crew must return on board at least ____ hours before the scheduled departure."
cases.reference_answer: Crew must return on board at least 2 hours before the scheduled departure.
